attribute.name: Delay
attribute.description: Delay of the inhibit signal 0 used for the generation of the BCR. The width of the inhibit is set to 51, which gives a range for the delay of 1..3511. This range corresponds to a real delay between ORBIT ECL input and the B-channel output of 57..3576BC. Notice, that the ORBIT NIM output is 1 BC later than the ORBIT ECL input.

class.name: TTCviBGoChannel
class.description: One of the four BGo channels of a TTCvi module.

attribute.name: ChannelNumber
attribute.description: BGo channel number

attribute.name: Selection
attribute.description: BGo Selection: External = BGo generated from front-panel input, VMEbus = BGo generated by VMEbus command.

attribute.name: CalibrationMode
attribute.description: Only possible for BGo-2

attribute.name: Retransmission
attribute.description: BGo FIFO: Retransmit = retransmit data after BGo FIFO becomes empty, Stop = stop after BGo FIFO becomes empty.

attribute.name: InhibitDelay
attribute.description: Delay of BGo Inhibit signal in BCs.

attribute.name: InhibitDuration
attribute.description: Duration of BGo Inhibit signal in BCs.

relationship.name: Cycles
relationship.description: Ordered list of cycles (long or short) for the BGo FIFO

attribute.name: OrbitInput
attribute.description: ORBIT input selection: can be internal or external (front panel)

attribute.name: CounterSelection
attribute.description: Event/Orbit counter selection

attribute.name: L1AInput
attribute.description: L1A input selection: can be external (front panel input 0, 1, 2 or 3), internal (using vme command or random generator), calibration or disabled. For LTP: L1A=ext0, TestTrigger1=1, ...

attribute.name: L1ARandomGeneratorFrequency
attribute.description: L1A random generator frequency

attribute.name: TriggerWordEnable
attribute.description: TriggerWord: Size bit in the Trigger Word register of TTCvi module. It becomes Short frame transfer if false(0). In this case, Event/Orbit Counter/Trigger-type transfers are inhibited.

attribute.name: TriggerWordExternal
attribute.description: TriggerWord:external is true(1)

attribute.name: TriggerWordAddress
attribute.description: TriggerWord:address (14-bit)

attribute.name: TriggerWordSubaddress
attribute.description: TriggerWord:subaddress (6-bit)

attribute.name: IS_server
attribute.description: Name of the IS server used

relationship.name: CyclesForConfigure
relationship.description: Ordered list of asychronous cycles (long or short) to be executed during configure

relationship.name: CyclesForConnect
relationship.description: Ordered list of asychronous cycles (long or short) to be executed during connect

relationship.name: CyclesForPrepareForRun
relationship.description: Ordered list of asychronous cycles (long or short) to be executed during prepareForRun

attribute.name: TTCrxAddress
attribute.description: 14-bit TTCrx address. 0=global addressing

attribute.name: Registers
attribute.description: Access internal or external TTCrx register

attribute.name: Subaddress
attribute.description: 8bit subaddress to be addressed

attribute.name: Command
attribute.description: 8-bit broadcast command

attribute.name: IS_server
attribute.description: Name of the IS server used

relationship.name: Configuration
relationship.description: Configuration object of the TTCvi, e.g. TTCviSimpleConfig or TTCviConfig

attribute.name: BCR_delay
attribute.description: Delay of the inhibit signal 0 used for the generation of the BCR. The width of the inhibit is set to 42(0x2A), which gives a range for the delay of 1..3520. This range corresponds to a real delay between ORBIT ECL input and the B-channel output of 48..3567BC. Notice, that the ORBIT NIM output is 1 BC later than the ORBIT ECL input.

attribute.name: TriggerWord
attribute.description: Enables the usage of the trigger word, with access to internal/external registers of the TTCrx.
